items.title: Jim H. Dunbar Jr. Interview, 1959-11-28
items.q: The interviewee discusses Bill Russell's public image and hypothetical desires ('What do you think Bill wants...'), but does not describe a personal interaction, professional collaboration, or close relationship.

ctx.x: I think he's gotten enough. I think it's finally coming to him now, you know. As you say, when they quote him, it's just Bill Russell or William Russell, and that is the best kind of a... True. That's the best kind of a thing from a public relations standpoint. He can really... Man, if he can just stand on the basis of just being there.

What do you think Bill wants, Dick? What do you think... If Bill could have anything he wanted, I don't mean any one thing, but if Bill could have a state, any combination of circumstances, what would it be that Bill would want?
